description: This file contains React components and utility functions for handling links, navigation, and trace attachments within a web-based test report UI, specifically for the Playwright HTML reporter.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: React component that conditionally renders children based on a predicate applied to URL search parameters.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: React component representing a styled clickable link that handles navigation.

classes.name: LinkBadge
classes.description: Styled badge version of Link with optional dimming.

classes.name: ProjectLink
classes.description: Component that creates a link to a specific project, modifying search parameters.

classes.name: AttachmentLink
classes.description: Component that renders a link or expandable view for test attachments, including handling of content type and body.

classes.name: TraceLink
classes.description: Component that provides a link to view trace attachments related to a test.

classes.name: SearchParamsProvider
classes.description: Context provider for managing URL search parameters within the app.

classes.name: Anchor
classes.description: Component that scrolls into view when anchored via URL parameters.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Function to programmatically change the browser URL and dispatch a popstate event.

methods.name: useSearchParams
methods.description: Custom hook to access URL search parameters from context.

methods.name: generateTraceUrl
methods.description: Creates a URL for trace attachments based on their paths.

methods.name: useAnchor
methods.description: Hook that triggers a callback when a specific anchor ID is active in URL parameters.

methods.name: useIsAnchored
methods.description: Determines if a given anchor ID is currently active based on URL parameters.

methods.name: testResultHref
methods.description: Generates a URL hash with test ID, result run index, and anchor for linking to specific test results.
